name: chatd
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater behavior: The macOS updater sets its feed URL, checks immediately and hourly, and accepts the downloaded update for installation on restart; the Windows path is explicitly disabled by the surrounding condition/comment.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish all released artifact signing and deployment details of the current upstream release.
Framework-delegated verification behavior depends on the packaged updater and release configuration.
